description: Self-hosted, fully offline AI-powered development platform — three-pillar system: Chat Engine, Visual Studio Integration, and Self-Iteration.
pillars: Pillar 1 — Chat Engine: context-aware, multi-turn conversational development assistant
Pillar 2 — Visual Studio Integration: native VSIX extension for Visual Studio 2022
Pillar 3 — Self-Iteration: autonomous roadmap-driven self-build loop

milestones.title: Self-Iteration — Autonomous Self-Build Loop
milestones.description: Arbiter reads its own roadmap, plans implementation steps, writes code, runs tests, and commits changes. Four autonomy modes from Assist to FullAuto.

tasks.title: SelfBuildController: orchestrator that reads roadmap.json, selects next pending task, coordinates pipeline
Four autonomy modes: Manual, Assist, SemiAuto, FullAuto — configurable per session
Task planning: AI generates step-by-step implementation plan for selected roadmap task
File identification: AI identifies which files need to be created or modified for each step
Code generation: AI writes full file content or unified diff for each change
Syntax validation: Python AST check / dotnet build dry-run before applying changes
Test execution: run pytest / dotnet test / npm test after applying changes
Iteration loop: if tests fail, AI revises changes up to 3 times before requesting human review
Git commit: structured commit message [arbiter-self-build] <task-id>: <description>
Roadmap update: mark task done, add implementation notes, set next task as in_progress
Self-build REST API: /self-build/start, /stop, /status, /approve, /reject, /log
tasks.notes: Self-build REST API added to server.py: /self-build/start, /stop, /status, /approve, /reject, /log, /roadmap, /next

tasks.title: Self-build panel in Monaco IDE: live task progress, diff preview, approve/reject buttons

Safety constraints: never push to remote without approval; protect config files in FullAuto mode
tasks.notes: BLOCKED_FILES list in core/self_build.py; /self-build/start mode parameter; protected files never auto-modified
